normative.title: Input identity
normative.statement: Preserve the input notice identity and the content used for a decision.
normative.rationale: Decisions must refer to the actual notice.
normative.preconditions: A readable notice with an explicit identity.
normative.expected: Output ID equals input ID; original input hash is retained.
normative.forbidden: Silent identity substitution.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Invalid input
normative.statement: Invalid or contradictory input must have an explicit uncertain/error disposition, retained evidence and preservation of the last valid snapshot.
normative.rationale: Prevent fabricated actionable facts.
normative.preconditions: Invalid, empty, contradictory or unsupported input.
normative.expected: Apply D5: retain input and reason; prohibit a successful negative or alert from invalidity; preserve valid state. Evaluate each requirement where its observations exist.
normative.forbidden: Silent valid-negative/small-impact fallback, fabricated facts or loss of the last valid snapshot.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Decision contract
normative.statement: Every successful decision exposes identity, binary signal classification, bounded numeric confidence, reasons, and extraction collections.
normative.rationale: Consumers need a stable observable contract.
normative.preconditions: Successful processing.
normative.expected: Finite confidence in [0,1], binary signal, nonempty reasons, lists for locations and restrictions.
normative.forbidden: Missing fields, NaN, infinity or out-of-range confidence.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Quantities and units
normative.statement: Numeric restrictions must be finite and nonnegative, carry a unit, and distinguish scheduled-to percent MDQ from volume reduction.
normative.rationale: Wrong quantities invert trading meaning.
normative.preconditions: Extracted restriction rows.
normative.expected: Scheduled-to percent MDQ in [0,100]; a nonnumeric unavailability restriction may have null value/unit.
normative.forbidden: Interpreting 55% scheduled as 55% reduction or imposing [0,100] on hourly entitlement percentages.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Restriction location linkage
normative.statement: Each extracted restriction must reference a location belonging to the same notice.
normative.rationale: Prevents assignment to the wrong constraint.
normative.preconditions: Extracted rows.
normative.expected: Unique location indexes and valid restriction-to-location joins.
normative.forbidden: Orphan restrictions or cross-notice joins.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Volume extraction
normative.statement: Extract the stated firm scheduled-to MDQ percentage on annotated notices.
normative.rationale: Measures semantic extraction independently of scoring.
normative.preconditions: An annotated firm percentage is present.
normative.expected: Equal the supplied HTML percentage, including field mutation.
normative.forbidden: Missing or numerically incorrect firm percentage.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Segment extraction
normative.statement: Retain annotated affected constraint segment identifiers.
normative.rationale: Identifiable constraints are required for decisions.
normative.preconditions: Annotated segment in supplied HTML.
normative.expected: Expected segment appears in extracted locations.
normative.forbidden: Missing or incorrect constraint segment.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Geography extraction
normative.statement: Retain annotated geographic zones without treating a name alone as proof of curtailment.
normative.rationale: Geography supports relevance but does not establish impact.
normative.preconditions: Annotated zone in supplied HTML.
normative.expected: Expected zone appears in location output; classification checked independently.
normative.forbidden: Loss of annotated zone.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Trading relevance and labeled evaluation
normative.statement: Classify notices from source-supported operational effects on gas flow or regional prices; routine, administrative and minor changes are not signals, and insufficient evidence remains unresolved.
normative.rationale: Makes baseline behavior independently assessable.
normative.preconditions: Accepted source facts and sufficient semantic evidence; frozen labels apply only to their separate historical evaluation.
normative.expected: Apply the supported behavioral contract without label lookup; report the frozen 14-case evaluation separately, including disagreements and unscorable cases. Labels never authorize runtime recommendations.
normative.forbidden: Relabeling examples to match implementation or treating execution failures as negatives.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Routine and administrative control
normative.statement: Routine administrative, IT and plan-index notices without operational flow restrictions must not signal.
normative.rationale: Avoid false trading signals from routine postings.
normative.preconditions: Routine administrative, IT or plan-index source content without an operational flow restriction.
normative.expected: No signal for routine content without operational restriction; supplied selected examples remain evaluation data.
normative.forbidden: Outage or maintenance words alone create a signal.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Critical disruption recall
normative.statement: Detect the labeled unplanned force-majeure disruption.
normative.rationale: Missing unplanned flow disruption is a high-risk outcome.
normative.preconditions: A source-supported material critical or unplanned operational disruption with sufficient semantic evidence.
normative.expected: Retain supported disruption candidates; typical signal characteristics are evidence, not an all-fields checklist. Frozen critical-case recall is a separate scoped evaluation.
normative.forbidden: Silent missed critical disruption.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Termination and prior context
normative.statement: Evaluate lifting a prior material restriction using available prior context and preserve case-specific termination labels.
normative.rationale: A lift can matter as much as onset.
normative.preconditions: A lift or termination with its explicit prior restriction and available source evidence.
normative.expected: Compare prior operational context; do not always suppress or always inherit signal classification. Unresolved materiality/history requires review; frozen examples remain evaluation-only.
normative.forbidden: A generic policy inferred from two conflicting-looking examples without human clarification.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Durable state
normative.statement: Successfully processed notices and their child records must survive database close and reopen.
normative.rationale: Restart must not lose evidence.
normative.preconditions: An acknowledged database insertion.
normative.expected: Reopened rows equal saved state; current notice exists.
normative.forbidden: Success with lost or absent rows.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Idempotent stored observations
normative.statement: Reprocessing identical notice content must not accumulate duplicate stored location or restriction observations.
normative.rationale: Repeated scraping must not multiply state.
normative.preconditions: Same notice processed repeatedly, including after restart.
normative.expected: Child rows per notice reflect the current extraction once; notice row is unique.
normative.forbidden: Duplicate child rows or multiple versions without explicit version identity.
normative.basis: inherited/database.py interface contract; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Already emitted signals
normative.statement: Automatic alerting must use the approved event identity, persistent alert keys and acknowledgement contract.
normative.rationale: Duplicate trading actions create risk.
normative.preconditions: A candidate for automatic alerting, including initial, update, replay and retry decisions.
normative.expected: Apply D1, D2 and D6: resolve the explicit chain and approval/actionability conditions; persist attempts and acknowledgements; reuse unacknowledged keys; retain uncertain candidates without automatic alerting.
normative.forbidden: Using classification labels or storage receipts as delivery approval; duplicate initial alerts or unsupported duplicate-free delivery claims.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Nonmaterial supersedes
normative.statement: A superseding notice with unchanged operational content must not generate another signal.
normative.rationale: Suppress routine revision noise.
normative.preconditions: A complete prior chain; source-supported unchanged operational content with only revision metadata or whitespace changes.
normative.expected: Classify the verified synthetic unchanged-body and repeated revision cases as non-signals; under D2/D6, withhold another alert for unchanged operational facts.
normative.forbidden: A new signal solely because identity/metadata changed; extrapolation to material updates or proof of delivered-alert deduplication.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Material revisions
normative.statement: Material revisions require explicit adjudication and linked initial/update decisions while preserving source conflicts for review.
normative.rationale: Do not hide changed operational risk.
normative.preconditions: A revision changes operational facts, or an existing notice ID arrives with different source content.
normative.expected: Apply D2: distinguish first initial alert, linked update and unacknowledged retry. Retain conflicting captures, preserve the last accepted snapshot and require review before changed content authorizes alerts.
normative.forbidden: Unconditional supersede suppression; a second initial alert after an existing attempt; automatic overwrite, merge, discard or reconciliation of source conflicts.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Replay and restart
normative.statement: Replay after reopening persistent state must preserve stored observation idempotency.
normative.rationale: Reproducible restart behavior.
normative.preconditions: Identical notice replay after close/reopen.
normative.expected: Current extraction appears once after replay.
normative.forbidden: Accumulation due solely to process lifetime.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Available prior lineage
normative.statement: A referenced prior notice that is available must be recoverable through the stored notice chain.
normative.rationale: Decisions need traceable context.
normative.preconditions: Prior row exists before evaluation.
normative.expected: Chain includes referenced prior and current identities.
normative.forbidden: Missing or fabricated available-prior linkage.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Missing prior notices
normative.statement: Missing or disputed prior history must block automatic alerting while preserving the input, gap and uncertain candidate.
normative.rationale: Do not hide context gaps.
normative.preconditions: An ancestor is missing or a chain is disputed, cyclic or conflicting.
normative.expected: Apply D1/D3: retain missingness and defer automatic alerting; new history may support a new linked reconciliation decision.
normative.forbidden: Invented priors, silently complete history, discarded uncertain candidates or retroactive replacement of earlier missingness.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Out-of-order processing
normative.statement: Out-of-order arrivals must reconcile to an order-independent final view under fixed accepted evidence.
normative.rationale: Arrival order is not event chronology.
normative.preconditions: The same accepted source versions, normalized facts, reference time and approved adjudications, processed in different orders.
normative.expected: Apply D3: create linked reconciliation decisions, preserve earlier uncertainty and historical delivery attempts; compare final views using fixed facts.
normative.forbidden: Using ID sort as chronology; demanding identical stochastic regeneration or identical real-time delivery histories.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Late notices
normative.statement: Late-notice actionability must use explicit source-time semantics and a supplied reference clock, separate from historical label scoring.
normative.rationale: Historical relevance differs from current actionability.
normative.preconditions: A decision about current alerting, including late notices and unresolved point changes.
normative.expected: Apply D3/D6: record source/publication/ingestion times and timezone-aware UTC reference time. Ended restrictions are historical-only for new disruption alerts; unresolved times/lifts require human actionability review.
normative.forbidden: Implicit machine/model clock, invented age cutoff, rescoring historical labels against today or treating known labels as alert permission.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Historical explainability
normative.statement: Past decisions must be retrievable by immutable identity with exactly the context available at decision time.
normative.rationale: Mutable state alone cannot explain past decisions.
normative.preconditions: A past successful, failed or deferred decision, including after later corrections or revisions.
normative.expected: Apply D4: retain and retrieve input, prior versions/missingness, clocks, facts, reasons, adjudications, implementation/policy/model identities and applicable delivery records. Later information creates linked decisions.
normative.forbidden: Backfilling later facts into old explanations, replacing earlier evidence, automatic assessment pruning, credential retention or claiming a complete service from current snapshots.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Execution failures are not behavior
normative.statement: Provider, environment, harness and unknown failures must not be reported as valid behavioral decisions.
normative.rationale: A fallback can conceal an invalid baseline.
normative.preconditions: Every execution.
normative.expected: Separate execution-domain failures from application dispositions and harness verdicts. An unusable model verdict cannot become a valid negative/small-impact result. Classification is unscorable only without its semantic result; other observable requirements remain evaluable.
normative.forbidden: PASS from a mock, silent fallback, invalid helper verdict or credential failure; blanket exclusion of independently observable structure/state/failure handling.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Unsupported and OOD inputs
normative.statement: Unsupported inputs must retain explicit uncertainty/error evidence and withhold automatic alerting within the approved assessment scope.
normative.rationale: Constrain autonomy to demonstrated evidence.
normative.preconditions: Unsupported formats, pipelines, ambiguous assertions or insufficient source support.
normative.expected: Apply D5/D6: retain reason and input; preserve last valid state. Missing optional strong-signal fields alone are not malformed. Unsupported annotations are unapproved or not evaluated and listed.
normative.forbidden: Extrapolating the labeled corpus or narrow source-supported fields to general production safety or fabricating missing facts.
normative.basis: Challenge v5 pp. 2, 4–5: broad lifecycle/refusal/evidence obligations; exact bounded behavior is an owner-approved assessment assumption under ADR 006.

normative.title: Evidence provenance
normative.statement: Every run must retain input, spec, requirements, implementation, model/prompt and dependency identities plus raw output and prior state.
normative.rationale: Supports independent review and reproduction.
normative.preconditions: Every harness run.
normative.expected: Retain input hashes, model request IDs, raw output, prior state and spec/rule/code/dependency/model/prompt identities. New policy applies only to new identified evaluations; historical evidence keeps its original policy.
normative.forbidden: Unattributed or reused historical results presented as fresh.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Inherited integrity
normative.statement: The inherited source and supplied data must remain unchanged through baseline collection.
normative.rationale: Preserves a trustworthy comparison point.
normative.preconditions: Baseline preparation and execution.
normative.expected: Before/after hashes match approved inherited snapshot.
normative.forbidden: Repairing inherited implementation before evidence exists.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained

normative.title: Regression/change evidence
normative.statement: Compare requirement results and observable decisions when implementation, prompt, model, source, dependency or specification changes.
normative.rationale: Changes need attributable evidence.
normative.preconditions: A baseline or comparable run exists.
normative.expected: Three primary gates; new pass/fail, unchanged and unexpected differences reported; first-run comparison is UNKNOWN.
normative.forbidden: Calling absent comparison PASS or changing requirements to clear failures.
normative.basis: inherited/design.md; challenge v5; exact existing contract retained
